reviews.text:
Got blood tests and an x-ray done for my cat. Asked to get a copy of my cat's x-rays before I left and they said they'd send it but never did. I called to follow up and they said they'd send it. They didn't. Emailed as well. Weeks passed and no response.

I spent hundreds of dollars and couldn't even get a copy of my cat's x-rays for her medical records.

If you need a copy of your records, you may have to return in person and demand they give you a copy. Otherwise you spent your money for them to delete your pet's medical records after a couple of years --- IF they're even filing the records in the first place.

DO NOT GO

I adopted a cat and turned out he has URI.

I took him in, the assistant couldn’t even tell he’s a Devon Rex. I tried correcting her but she kept speaking it’s a sphynx. Then, the doctor came in. He immediately said my cat is a sphynx mixed with another cat. I told him it’s a devon rex, and he continued to say he’s a sphynx mixed with devon rex. But devon rexs have shedding periods so younger devons can be a bit bald. I originally wanted to go to other hospitals near me but they were all booked out. I was hesitant to coming here because they’ve let so many people’s little babies die… However, Chat said if I’m just taking my cat here for a quick checkup it should be okay. So I came. But the moment they started examining my cat I lost my hopes. How can I expect someone who doesn’t even know basic information on my cat’s breed, cure my cat?

He gave my cat shots and medications that goes for two weeks. It’s been almost two weeks since, but he’s still sick. He’s still having eye discharges and runny nose.

Do not come here even if your pet has just a common problem or slight sickness.

Also the price is a bit high for what they actually do there and the overall environment.

DO NOT GO
Very accurate, fast and affordable esp when u need all documents for ur pet’s international travel, highly recommend, one of a kind

A lot of these small places are closed this smog in particular tried to hustle me an extra amount of money if I needed a star location, which for my situation, I did not need a star location, also they actually close at 6 PM not 7 PM, such an inconvenience and inconsiderate to my day smh.
I loved it, they are really very kind and the place is very nice, and they treated my dog ​​very well. I highly recommend it.
So far I like the doctors here.
You get the quality of care you pay for, it can be quick but your pet barely gets glanced at.

Update: 06/09/2026: Subsequent to my negative review below, I received an email stating that I was banned, citing to my negative review as the reason.

Our new vet is Grand Park Animal Hospital. Truly A+ customer service and attention to your pet (offered us water - me  and my pet while we waited, parking is validated 3hrs so you can shop around the mall, prices are comparable but for the couple extra bucks soooo worth it).

06/01/2026: Clinic requires that you have all your pets vaccines done here before they conduct any service,  even if that requires double vaccinating your pup. Rabbies: $20, Bordatella: $24, DA2PP: $24. In addition, you must schedule a routine exam $60 to receive any service whatsoever. The routine exam, in my experience, consists of the vet conducting an oral exam of less than a minute and checking the heart beat. (At another clinic, at least the vet conducted a reflex test on my pup. Not here.) Used to come here because it was cheap to get an allergy shot for my dog but  not anymore. For the cost, you can receive better customer care elsewhere.

I brought in a stray cat, estimated to be around 4 years old, that I had recently started acclimating to life indoors. Vermont Animal Hospital became her very first veterinary clinic, and in a single day they completed a full examination, vaccinations, bloodwork, and her spay surgery.

During the process, one of the veterinary technicians was unfortunately scratched and visibly injured while handling my cat. I felt terrible because it happened while caring for a stray that I had brought in. When I apologized and asked if she was okay, she simply smiled and said, “It’s part of the job. Thank you for bringing in a stray cat and giving her a chance.”

That response genuinely touched me.

What impressed me most was that the entire staff seemed far more concerned about my cat’s well-being than their own discomfort. Even after being scratched, they continued giving me advice and reminding me to be careful when bringing her back for her follow-up visit in two weeks.

The pricing was also very reasonable and transparent, and I never felt pressured into unnecessary treatments or expenses. The staff was compassionate, professional, and truly dedicated to helping animals.

This experience left a lasting impression on me, and I’m incredibly grateful for the kindness and care they showed both me and my cat. I highly recommend Vermont Animal Hospital to anyone looking for a veterinary team that genuinely cares.

Dr. Lee is so patient and kind.  I left a message to talk to Dr. Lee about the eye medicine we got for my dog and he called me back less than 1 hour.  For my other vet, I had to leave 3-4 message to get her call back.  Dr. Lee explained about the medicines again and he reassured that it is normal for me having a hard time putting the eye drop on my dog's eye.  He gave me a few tips to do it easier.  He also offered me to bring back my dog before our next appointment  if I want to, since it is free to see the doctor again within a month.  I feel so relieved to have Dr. Lee as our vet.

Dr.Lee is very kind and he explained every details unlike other vet I have been seeing. Very trustworthy.  He examed Chowder very thoroughly and he even had me follow him to the back room to see Chowder's test result.  I am so glad to find the amazingly kind vet I dreamed for my Chowder and Chai.
VERMONT ANIMAL HOSPITAL is AMAZING. They gave me medicine for my dog & tested his stool. Without him being present. Staff is always welcoming and polite. EXTREMELY CLEAN!
Pretty good animal hospital but expensive

This clinic is not reliable. I took my French bulldog to do tests since she was pregnant, they told me that only 2 to 3 puppies were coming, they would do cesarean section. They recommended me another place. I went and my dog had 6 puppies.

To: Julie Coronado
I don’t know whether you will ever read this, but reading your devastating story made me break down in tears. The unbearable pain and grief I went through two years ago came flooding back, and it feels impossible to breathe. I know exactly how heartbroken you are. I know how deep and crushing this pain is.

My dog also died at this hospital two years ago during a neutering surgery. She never woke up. I was told she died just 45 minutes after I left her there. I ran back screaming and crying like I had lost my mind. When I saw her, her mouth was tied with a green string, and her body was already lifeless and collapsed.

The veterinarian simply said, “We don’t know the reason.” That was it. No explanation. No responsibility. They then casually told me I could just leave my dead dog there and they would handle the cremation, as if her life meant nothing.

Julie, how can anyone possibly comfort you? Seeing the photos of your beautiful girl tears my heart apart. She was so precious, so full of life. There are already reviews here saying that pets have died during neutering surgeries or treatments at this hospital. If I had read those reviews beforehand, could I have avoided this lifelong trauma?

I am furious. I am devastated. And even after two years, I am still trapped in the pain and horror of that day. This hospital should never be allowed to perform surgeries. What happened to your sweet girl and to my dog should never happen to anyone else.

Great vet, reasonable price friendly staff.
I really can't say more, just highly recommend it.

Please do not bring your dog here. Came for a routine spay and never saw my baby again. Dropped my 1 year old, healthy, happy baby off for her spay appointment then got a call 2 hours later letting me know that her heart suddenly stopped during recovery and that she had passed away. Rushed to the vet to see my baby and see her little body stiff and cold and the only explanation I get from Dr. Hyung Jun An is “I don’t know what happened.” I so much regret bringing my baby here and hope no other pet parent has to go through this.
I took my pet Fany there, she was medicated and had a quick recovery. Excellent service and very accurate.

Dr Lee is an amazing Veterinarian.  I had just adopted a pup from the San Bernardino animal shelter and he was terribly sick with Parvo.  After getting care from Dr. Lee my pup is strong and healthy.  I am very thankful for the kindness, politeness and patience from Dr. Lee!
Rude for no reason didn’t even let me talk and the guy on the phone just hung up when all I wanted was to have my car seen
My favorite vet that I've visited, been going here for about 4 years since I found them. They're very honest, have excellent prices and are really great with animals and owners.
The teacher is super kind, highly recommend it

My husband took my dogs for a check up. This clinic is very affordable. Check up, with medicine and shampoo all for a good price. He mention how wonderful they were and informative they were about the dog's needs.
Very kind and reasonable price,and this doctor is very honest.

Extremely unsanitary clinic and unorganized. Every single time I visit, the exam tables are NEVER cleaned. Wiping down the exam tables & weight scales in between each patient is literally the bare minimum and standard practice.. Skipping that part just makes no sense. The exam tables have visible paw prints, fur, wet stains, etc and I cant believe YOU have to be one asking them to wipe it down before you put your pet on the table. It’s just so disgusting and I can no longer trust somewhere like this that will consistently, without a fail, skip over the most basic part of medical practice.

Also, most vet clinics take a temperature of your pet before giving vaccinations to make sure they dont have a fever but this clinic doesnt bother to do that. You’re paying $70+ for vaccines just for them to skip over the basics. Lastly, if you’re a cat owner, I wouldnt recommend this clinic because they treat cats like they’re all feral and aggressive. They dont even bother taking your cat out of the carrier for vaccines. I’ve NEVER been to a vet clinic who wont even look at the condition of a cat they’re giving the vaccine to. Doesnt check to see if they’re healthy enough to receive vaccines like 99% of other clinics do.

Had a horrible experience elsewhere and heard by word of mouth that the staff and veterinarian here were kind to their patients and the owners. Needless to say, we've found our new primary veterinarian! Highly recommend this place for people who have anxious/fearful pets. The staff are empathetic and do their best to work with the patients' temperaments. Prices are also extremely affordable!

We first brought our cat here because she was peeing all over the house, clearly in distress. The vet did no urinalysis, no imaging, no proper exam at all, just brushed us off and sent us home.

Months later, with the same problem still happening, we brought her back. Again, no testing. They just gave us an antibiotic and a pain med without ever figuring out the cause. When I asked if maybe she was stressed and needed anti-anxiety meds, they prescribed EIGHT times the normal starting dose of Prozac for her weight. Our cat immediately started twitching, zoning out, and acting strange for days. When I researched the dosage, I confirmed they had overdosed her. I called to report this and asked for a callback, they never called me back.

During that same visit, I asked a medical question, and I literally watched the vet pull up ChatGPT on his computer and type it in instead of giving me an informed answer.

Now we’ve gone to another vet and found out what was really wrong: our cat has stones in her bladder. This is something that could have been diagnosed and managed months ago with a simple urinalysis or X-ray, but instead she’s been in pain all this time because this clinic dismissed our concerns and never bothered to check.

DO NOT trust this place with your pets!! Their negligence has caused our cat months of unnecessary suffering.

Best Vet in SoCal in my opinion!  It's a drive for me ...  I live in Long Beach but totally worth the drive. Dr.An and his team are so calm and professional.  Facility is super clean.  Parking is plentiful.  And they don't charge a ridiculous amount.  No wonder they have so many customers.

I needed to get rabies antibody tests done before leaving for Korea, so I called around to various places, but this was the cheapest, so I ended up coming here! The clinic interior is really clean.

All the staff were kind, and I especially loved that the doctor examined both of my dogs thoroughly right in front of me, talking to me as he did so, without any unnecessary treatment.

Honestly, I pay $60 per dog just for the doctor's visit.

At the other clinic I went to before, the doctor just glanced at them (pretending not to look) and said what he wanted to say, then made me talk to the nurse for the rest.

Whenever I asked a question there, he would try to steer me toward prescribing medication, injections, or additional tests, making me feel like he was only interested in money.

Coming here after going to that clinic, not only were they meticulous in examining the dogs and explaining everything, but they also calmly and accurately informed me about the antibody test results (whether they would come back quickly or slowly), the prices, and the expected return dates. I really appreciated that!

Thank you. If I have a reason to visit before going to Korea, I will come back again.
The Korean guy is rude. And a few days later my dog passed away because there were not being careful with injecting a tube that hit his heart DONT NOT COME HERE
Service was quick, prices affordable and the staff was kind and attentive .

I’ve been bringing my dog to Vermont Animal Hospital  and have always felt comfortable here—until recently. On Thursday, I had a very frustrating and upsetting experience with the Korean front desk staff, who has consistently been rude and unhelpful. I’ve witnessed this behavior not only toward me but also toward other clients.

That day, I simply asked if I could speak with the doctor. Instead of trying to assist, the receptionist closed the door, pretended to talk to the doctor, and came back saying he was unavailable—offering no alternative or solution. I left the clinic and called shortly afterward to try again. She told me the doctor was with a patient and abruptly hung up on me.

When I called again, the doctor himself answered. I explained what had happened and expressed how uncomfortable the receptionist’s attitude His response shocked me:
“Okay, just go to another clinic. Scream at me.”

I was speechless. There was no apology, no attempt to understand my concern—just

After all feel so dismissed and disrespected.

The truth is, this clinic care more about money than about the animals or the people who love them.  reconsiders how they treat their clients—because compassion should always come first in animal care.

My dog and I were fortunate enough to move near Dr. Anh and Dr. Lee to have them as her primary care veterinarians. They have selected such a lovely staff who are also knowledgable and kind. They are a trilingual vet-- able to help in Spanish, Korean and English! Their prices are very reasonable and the office is super clean.
I saw some negative reviews about this business not being able to help in urgent situations, but my experience has been different. As an existing patient, they have been able to accommodate me in the same day for walk-in appointments, which are slightly more expensive than scheduled appointments, but we were able to get help in the same day.
===
Adding to my review to say they are also super quick with Health Certificates for travel and Rabies Titer Tests for the FAVN. They offer very reasonable prices for this too. These services are expensive regardless, but they make it easy and affordable. We only travel to Honolulu, but I have also seen them issue health certificates for international travel as well. Such an impressive, clean and well maintained practice. The front office staff are always so pleasant and kind, and make the ambiance a peaceful one for the pets who are understandably stressed. THANK YOU!!!!
Great fast easy and very gentle with your pet.

My first visit to Vermont Pet Hospital on 06/16/2025 was a deeply moving experience. From the moment I arrived, I was greeted with plenty of parking and a spacious, welcoming lounge staffed by three kind and attentive front desk team members. The consultation rooms were clean, private, and comfortable, providing a sense of calm during a difficult time.

I brought my beloved 18-year-old feline in for euthanasia after a long, challenging battle with illness. I was overwhelmed with sadness, but right from the start, the staff made me feel genuinely cared for and supported. I had a one-on-one consultation with the compassionate Dr. Lee, whose knowledgeable and thoughtful answers to all my questions eased my worries and helped me feel more at peace. And the cost was reasonable.

The entire process was handled with the utmost respect, kindness, and sensitivity. During a particularly emotional moment, one of the staff came in and offered me a comforting hug, which I deeply appreciated. At the end of the visit, Dr. Lee bowed to me—a rare and profound gesture of respect that touched me deeply, and I reciprocated with gratitude.

Though saying goodbye to my cherished companion was heartbreaking, Dr. Lee and his staff made a difficult time more bearable with their genuine compassion and professionalism. I am sincerely grateful for their heartfelt care and support.

Thank you, Dr. Lee and team, for your extraordinary service and kindness during such a tender moment in my life.
Great clinical service from the doctor and staff at reasonable charges!!
Friendly staff and very affordable.

Honestly I’ve yet to have a bad experience here. I’ve come a couple times to get my cats checked up. Staff is friendly and I get seen fairly quickly but there is a bit of a wait. Overall though I would recommend coming here :)
Fast, friendly vet with plenty of parking

I came here to get my dog flea medication. He was constantly scratching from the flea bites and now I rarely see him scratch. He got a shot for dermatitis and flea medication. Also the doctor was on time and efficient.

Recently, my mom had a very upsetting experience at the hospital. While she was in the exam room speaking with the staff, a young doctor suddenly entered, blocked her, and abruptly stated that our cat shouldn’t receive the vaccine. Our family has been visiting this hospital for a long time and had explicitly requested Dr. An, so we were confused about why she ended up seeing someone else. When she asked the staff, they explained that he was a new doctor.

How can that new doctor barge in and scold the staff in front of my mom? His behavior was unprofessional and extremely rude. We never want to experience that again and certainly don’t want to see him in the future. He seriously needs to improve his customer service and communication skills.
Nice and affordable clinic
It's a hospital, but they don't see walk-ins... I think it should be called a clinic! 👎 …

I recently had a very disappointing experience with the front desk staff at  Vermont animal hospital . During my visit, the receptionist was rude and dismissive when I had questions about my pet’s care. When I later called to file a complaint about the incident, the same staff member argued with me over the phone instead of addressing my concerns professionally.

I expect a higher level of respect and customer service from a clinic that is entrusted with my pet’s health and well-being. This interaction has made me reconsider returning, and I hope management addresses these issues to prevent future experiences like this for other clients.

If you have an emergency and need to act quickly to save your pet, stay away from this place. My dog ​​had eaten rice in the plastic and sugar on the 24th, which was what I believed to be the first thing, and then she started vomiting the next day. I took her to my veterinarian first, and the problem persisted, so I started from there. He recommended an x-ray and a blood test. He said everything was normal and that it was just gas. He prescribed a medicine that stopped the vomiting and diarrhea. However, my dog ​​was constipated and did not have diarrhea, and the plan of action should have been to remove what she had ingested and not something to contain the feces. Well, trusting the doctor, who I thought was competent, I took my dog ​​home and treated her as recommended, but she continued to be constipated, until one morning she simply defecated only blood from her anus, a significant amount. So I ran to them, before they even opened. He left there saying that he was going to do an endoscopy, and that I should pick her up at 4 pm. I spent the whole day waiting for some news and nothing. But I thought everything was fine. However, when I went to pick up my dog, he said he couldn't do the endoscopy because it was blocked and that I had said she was spayed, but that it didn't seem like she had been spayed, and that was why he couldn't insert the tube, with those exact words. I immediately questioned him: what did the stomach have to do with my dog's uterus???? He said it was confusing and couldn't explain it to me. From then on, with this nonsensical argument, I was afraid he would open my dog ​​up to operate. The first time he said it was gas, which made her situation worse, and the second time he gave this nonsensical justification!!! At that point, my daughter was wasting her time, and I took her home in a worse state than I had left her. I spent the last night in terror with my daughter. The vomiting returned, the defecation was only blood, and she started to faint. Something very wrong happened there. The next morning, on the way to another hospital, my daughter passed away… I believed and trusted this incompetent hospital twice. They don’t have the level of knowledge to deal with emergencies. This couldn’t even be called a hospital. My daughter spent 5 days in agony in pain, and her situation was made worse by a wrong diagnosis and medical negligence.
thank you Doctor for helping my dog and me, this place is great doctor and staffs are very nice. My dog 🐶 is very sick. and the support I been given has been amazing. thank you to everyone 😔 …

Friendly compassionate staff. Sadly I recently had to take my dog to put her down due to her deteriorating condition and they made it very easy for me during this very difficult moment. My dog was in a state where she could no longer move her hind legs making it impossible for her to walk and two staff members came out with a gurney to help carry her from my car to a room. The Vet explained the process in a very simple understandable way, and allowed me extra time to say my goodbyes. They take walk-ins but appointments are recommended if you’re looking to be in and out as quickly as possible.

How far is the thermo stick supposed to go up the anus of a puppy to check if it’s sick? One of the staff members placed it in kinda far in my opinion more than an inch and my pup started pooping. That same staff and another found it adorable for some reason. This happened long ago. The vet himself seems to care and the prices are affordable. She was sick when I first took her here, but nobody told me she was sick, so she eventually died. They were compassionate when I put her down, so you get what you pay for I guess.

I don’t recommend, the employees at the desk are extremely rude. I called before an appointment to ask them if they can still see my dog if I am late and gave them an ETA, which was 15 minutes past my appointment time. I came at the time I told them, and they said they cannot see me and refused to open the door because their grace period is only 10 minutes. My dog had been throwing up nonstop for a week and I had let them know that the appointment time was the only time I could do for a while since I was a student. They had absolutely no compassion, did not let me in, and did not apologize for giving the wrong information over call.

I understand that I was late, but I had called beforehand to confirm if I can come in and they said yes. This is only for the employees at the front desk, I truly hope the doctor replaces them.

I have been coming here for five years. We have been monitoring my dog's heart murmur. And, recently, he went into heart failure a couple of years ago. But we have been prepared for it and started with medication right on time. I love this place.
This is a place where people don't care about animals, only about money. I never want to go there again. I would never recommend this place. They have no conscience.

I settled here for years after experiencing several hospitals.
The doctor is definitely not friendly, but the treatment is accurate and it's cheaper than anywhere else.
One time, I went to a general hospital because my cat was sick and couldn't make an urgent appointment here, but I was diagnosed with having to undergo surgery and the cost was enormous.
I couldn't afford it, so I managed to reschedule my appointment and went back to the Vermont Animal Hospital, and with an unexpectedly simple treatment, my cat became healthy.
Don't be fooled by the procedures and tricks of the general hospital.
I got my puppy's vaccinations here. The staff was very friendly, and the clinic is very clean with excellent facilities. Thank you to Dr. An for the kind and detailed explanation.

THIS VET IS A TOTAL FAILURE.

I called for an appt for my dog's ear infection and was told to go in the next day at 2PM. I was told that consultation fee is $60 with appointment and $80 for walk in. Who wants to walk in and having to wait and pay extra? This doesn't make sense but whatever, the vet isn't that busy since they can give next day appt. The fees seems rather high for a vet in a deplorable hispanic area.

On day of appointment, I arrived 15 mins earlier, there were 2 homeless men sleeping in front of the hospital and that was such a sense of arrival.
I was quickly checked in and ushered to a room to take the vitals and was told that the vet will be in shortly. I sat in that small room with my dog for 40 minutes and there is no sign of vet so after 45 minutes of waiting in the consultation room, i walked out, told the staff to forget it and left.

NEVER EVER AGAIN I will come here to experience the kind of unprofessionalism let alone his expertise becomes questionable as well. I would doubt his Korean qualification to practice veterinarian in US and certainly his mannerism.

I have been coming here for my dog Charlie for 4 years. I absolutely love this place. The doc noticed Charlie has a heart murmur a few years ago. We have been motioning it and gradually started introducing medication when it became …

I don't wanna recommend this place never EVER. my cat had surgery before but after surgery   burn skin damage week later got a trouble (infection) I've called and visited but they're ignored after care was HORRIBLE!!!!DON'T TRUST this place!!!  NO WAY !!!

This hospital doesn't know how to perform surgery. I had two failed surgeries for cystitis, and my cat ended up in the emergency room, spending a lot of money. It was mentally, physically, financially, and financially exhausting. I don't recommend this hospital.

Brought my dog who was dying in my arms and she needed oxygen and immediate attention and they said they wouldn’t help me because they’re on lunch. Who turns away a dying dog beacuse you’re on lunch? Horrible people here who don’t care …

The staff were so friendly.
I was worried because the teacher looked young, but he explained everything in detail, which was really nice. …
